SWK.why: A market leader in Industrials holding near its high after a normal pause, seated as one of the strongest names on the lists with no voice nominating it.
SWK.contested: Contested: part of the room wants to buy the dip back to the 20-day average rather than a breakout, and the backers share no single buy line; it clears on one agreed trigger level.

MGNI.why: A market leader at a new high on heavy buying, top of its group, but stretched well past its last pause.
MGNI.contested: Contested: the hold waits for a pullback to the broken level while part of the room would buy strength now; it clears on an hourly close above the prior day's high after that pullback, on heavy volume.

PG.why: A staples leader breaking to a new 52-week high with its averages stacked in order, a small push from its trigger.
PG.contested: Contested: the new high printed on below-average volume and part of the room would rather buy a pullback to value; it clears on a breakout bar at 1.4 times normal volume.

TMO.why: A healthcare leader at a new high just over its broken swing high, with the averages in order and a recent selling bar already reversed.
TMO.contested: Contested: the break came on below-average volume and the trend's force was interrupted; it clears on a push at 1.4 times normal volume once that force is steady again.

JNJ.why: A healthcare name breaking right at its pivot to a new 52-week high, with the daily and hourly trends rising in step.
JNJ.contested: Contested: the weekly trend still shows lower highs and the break came on light volume; it clears once the weekly prints a higher high and a breakout bar carries heavy volume.

SJM.why: A staples leader coiled just under its pivot on drying volume, on a reclaim day, in the room on a reserved reclaim seat with no voice nominating it.
SJM.contested: Contested: a close over this pivot may still sit under its recent high, so part of the room wants a new 52-week closing high instead, and earnings land on 24 Nov.

BDX.why: A healthcare leader rising on every timeframe and top of its group, but already 7.4% past its last swing high.
BDX.contested: Contested: the hold waits for a pullback to the broken level while part of the room would buy the new high now; it clears on that pullback and an hourly close above the prior day's high on heavy volume.

VSXY.why: A consumer leader at a new high with top-tier strength, but 21.6% past its last swing high, a move that has already left.
VSXY.contested: Contested: the hold waits for a pullback while part of the room would buy strength now, and the new high lacked breakout volume; it clears on that pullback and an hourly close above the prior day's high.

COR.why: A healthcare leader testing a fresh break of its swing high on above-average volume, third strongest in its group, kept after the second look.
COR.contested: Contested: the long-term averages are still out of order and the push is not yet a new high; it clears on a daily close at a fresh 52-week closing high on heavy volume.

CNK.why: A consumer name breaking to a new 52-week high and closing at the top of its day, back in the room after an earlier advance.
CNK.contested: Contested: the break came on average volume and the trend's force keeps flickering; it clears when that force holds steady for two sessions and a breakout bar carries heavy volume.

SONY.why: A technology leader just above its broken pivot, inside its buy window, still about 10% under its yearly high.
SONY.contested: Contested: the hold buys a dip back to the pivot and a reclaim while part of the room would buy the break now, and volume was just short of the breakout line; it clears on that reclaim on heavy volume.
